He encounters communal traditions, cutting-edge entertainment, and the people shaping modern China. The Lackovic case: to Gloria, Bruno denies killing him, but he confesses to Sonia, who has to decide which side she’s on. The Muslims are getting restless, but Amir helps Bruno with the message in the counterfeit book: it’s from a speech by Al-Iraqi.

Thus begins a treacherous 6000-kilometre trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. They have little food and few supplies, but together, they must withstand nature at is most extreme. Directed by Peter Weir and stars Jim Sturgess, Colin Farrell and Ed Harris.

Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what’s going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan (Godfrey Tearle) from sending secrets out of the country. Hannay is assisted by Pamela (Madeleine Carroll), an unwilling accomplice who discovers the truth.

Deadpan rich boy Harold (Bud Cort) keeps staging elaborate suicide tableaux to get the attention of his mother (Vivian Pickles), but she keeps planning his brilliant future for him instead. Obsessed with the trappings of death, Harold freaks out his blind dates, modifies his new sports car to look like a mini-hearse, and attends funerals, where he meets the spirited Maude (Ruth Gordon). An eccentric to the core, Maude lives exactly as she pleases, with avid collecting and nude modeling among her many pursuits. He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan (Godfrey Tearle) from sending secrets out of the country. Obsessed with the trappings of death, Harold freaks out his blind dates, modifies his new sports car to look like a mini-hearse, and attends funerals, where he meets the spirited Maude (Ruth Gordon). programme.desc: From the banks of Adelaide's beautiful River Torrens, Laura cooks a superb pasta dish of Garganelli with Braised Greens. Then we're up to tropical Noosa with Matt, who cooks a light, quick, and refreshing dish of Falafel Pitas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves to prepare simple recipes with the freshest of seafood. She creates halibut with saffron fregola, tuna chickpea salad, and shares a recipe moment with her grandson, Miles.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: In this concluding episode, Tom recalls life as a young chef in the competitive world of the professional kitchen.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: There are few people who can resist a sweet treat. Especially when it's an authentic, Italian offering. From biscotti to an espresso swirl cake, Silvia's twist on classic recipes are sure to delight.

programme.title: Food Safari
programme.desc: Maeve O'Meara discovers some of the vast range of flavours and dishes that can be found across the USA. Sydney chef George Francisco whips up his legendary Chesapeake Bay crab cakes with a spicy Cajun remoulade. Maeve then learns the secrets of the American barbecue from restaurateur Steve Johnson. And Californian expatriate John Boland shows Maeve how to make his renowned Californian fish tacos.

programme.title: Haigh's Chocolates - From Bean To Bar
programme.desc: A century-old family business evolves from a humble Adelaide confectioner into Australia’s finest chocolate maker.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Justine gets busy in the kitchen with a white chocolate mousse with Pedro Ximenez Prunes and some delicious kataifi prawns, and then Sydney based chef, Massimo Mele joins Justine.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a night of sensational seafood as Adam and his world-class guests, swimmer Ariarne Titmus and chef Alejandro Saravia, share how they reel in a crowd.

programme.title: Instant Italian
programme.desc: Anna's throwing an Italian Snacking Party and showing how to make her guests' favorite make-ahead snacks, such as Sicilian-style Chicken Spiedini and Neapolitan Fried Eggplant Sandwiches.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Usa
programme.desc: Bill and Paul ride into their hometown of Bryan-College Station Texas, where the town is being over run by Wild Boars. They head out on a night hunt with state-of-the-art military-grade equipment and Bill bags a big pig. Next they visit a true Texas cowboy who shows them the secret to cooking pig in a make-shift oven buried in the ground. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.title: Jamie's Super Food
programme.desc: On the Greek island of Ikaria Jamie finds out how wholegrain cracked wheat- which could be one of the reasons local people live so long - is prepared the traditional way and helps make Trahana.

programme.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
programme.sub-title: Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar
programme.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me: The Professionals
programme.desc: Today we're in and around Birmingham and Wolverhampton and first up is Adians Dining where chef Adian and fiance and front of house manager Eloise are showcasing their Caribbean-Asian fusion menu.

programme.desc: Hosts Adam Liaw, Renee Lim and Lily Serna meet passionate growers, celebrated chefs and local food heroes from all over Australia.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk. However, until quite recently, the only specialist cheeses available in the country came from Europe.

programme.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty

programme.desc: Rolf and Neel pays Hoxa a visit at his mansion, to confront him with a new evidence; Mario's debt increases and in order to pay it off, he needs to complete a new, risky task.

programme.desc: Rolf, Claire and Karol don't get much help from the nuns as they try to find answers in a monastery, but Rolf nevertheless gets hold of material that reveals a connection to a fertility clinic.

programme.desc: This episode kicks off with Kate Humble and her Welsh Sheepdog Teg exploring remote North Wales. Kate reaches for the sky, amidst a storm with 50 mph winds, as she attempts to climb the tallest man-made structure in Wales, the Arfon Transmission Tower, to fix some loose cables.

programme.title: Off The Beaten Track With Kate Humble
programme.desc: In mid-Wales, Kate and Teg have a taste of Stone Age life, mucking in with a farmer and an archaeologist who are building a medieval settlement to bring to life the past in order to understand how we used to live. Next, they explore the potential death traps of our historical legacies, at an old lead mine, where the South and Mid Wales Cave Rescue Team practice their skills.

There he takes to the water with four-times paralympian, Hannah Stodel. After a quick stop on the distinctive 18-mile-long Chesil Beach, Michael makes his way to Abbotsbury Swannery to take in the amazing sight of their 800-strong colony of Mute Swans.

Deadpan rich boy Harold (Bud Cort) keeps staging elaborate suicide tableaux to get the attention of his mother (Vivian Pickles), but she keeps planning his brilliant future for him instead. Obsessed with the trappings of death, Harold freaks out his blind dates, modifies his new sports car to look like a mini-hearse, and attends funerals, where he meets the spirited Maude (Ruth Gordon). An eccentric to the core, Maude lives exactly as she pleases, with avid collecting and nude modeling among her many pursuits. programme.title: Paul Merton: Driving Amazing Trains
programme.desc: On the beautiful Isle of Wight Paul follows in the footsteps of his tube driver Dad by riding up front on the very trains his father would have driven on the Northern Line - now in service on the island. After driving a heritage steam loco Paul helps a cow give birth before driving a sit-on tiny steam train at Cowes. His journey finishes with a look at how the Island was prepped in secret to help with D-Day.

programme.title: China With Ben Fogle
programme.desc: Ben's adventure begins at the Great Wall before plunging into the vibrant life of Beijing and Shanghai. He encounters communal traditions, cutting-edge entertainment, and the people shaping modern China. From high-speed trains to Hollywood-scale film studios, fortune-telling cocktail bars to the explosive rise of mobile micro-dramas, this is China as you have never seen it before.

programme.title: Rock Legends
programme.desc: Primal Scream, the Scottish rock band formed in 1982, are celebrated for fusing rock, dance, and psychedelic sounds. Hits like "Loaded", "Rocks", and "Movin' On Up" brought them worldwide acclaim, cementing their influence on alternative music and the Madchester scene.

programme.title: SBS World News Late
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: The King
programme.desc: Bruno isolates the Muslim wing and enrages the secret services. Adele finds out Gloria is having an affair with her oncologist and repairs to her father’s place. The Lackovic case: to Gloria, Bruno denies killing him, but he confesses to Sonia, who has to decide which side she’s on. The Muslims are getting restless, but Amir helps Bruno with the message in the counterfeit book: it’s from a speech by Al-Iraqi.

programme.title: Babylon Berlin
programme.desc: Malu Seegers and Dr Volcker pursue a deadly plan; Charlotte makes a terrible discovery; Helga tries to escape from her kidnappers.

programme.title: The Rover
programme.desc: 10 years after a global economic collapse, a hardened loner pursues the men who stole his only possession, his car. Along the way, he captures one of the thieves' brothers, and the duo form an uneasy bond during the dangerous journey.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Inspired by an incredible true story, The Way Back begins in 1940 when seven prisoners attempt the impossible: escape from a brutal Siberian gulag. Thus begins a treacherous 6000-kilometre trek to freedom across the world's most merciless landscapes. They have little food and few supplies, but together, they must withstand nature at is most extreme. Directed by Peter Weir and stars Jim Sturgess, Colin Farrell and Ed Harris.

programme.title: Open The Wall
programme.desc: A comic look at the fall of the Berlin Wall in November of 1989, told from the point of view of the German border guards at the checkpoint where it all started.

programme.title: Discovering Film: Robert Donat
programme.desc: Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the `golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: When self-taught mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan fails out of college, he does not give up hope. Determined to pursue his passion, he contacts Professor G.H. Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: Girl America
programme.desc: Girl America tells the emotional journey of a girl growing up under communist Czechoslovakia, facing hardship and fighting for redemption and hope for a better life in America.

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what’s going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The 39 Steps
programme.desc: While on vacation in London, Canadian Richard Hannay (Robert Donat) becomes embroiled in an international spy ring related to the mysterious "39 steps." Then he meets agent Annabella Smith (Lucie Mannheim), who is soon killed in his apartment. He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan (Godfrey Tearle) from sending secrets out of the country. Hannay is assisted by Pamela (Madeleine Carroll), an unwilling accomplice who discovers the truth.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Mary is born in India to wealthy British parents. When her parents suddenly die, she is sent back to England to live with her uncle. She soon discovers a magical garden hidden at her uncle's estate.

programme.title: And So It Goes
programme.desc: There are a million reasons not to like the self-absorbed realtor, Oren Little. But his life gets turned upside-down when his estranged son, Luke appears out of the blue when he asks him to temporarily care for a nine-year old granddaughter her didn't know existed.

programme.title: Harold And Maude
programme.desc: A teenager with a death wish and a 79-year-old high on life find love in Hal Ashby's cult black comedy. Deadpan rich boy Harold (Bud Cort) keeps staging elaborate suicide tableaux to get the attention of his mother (Vivian Pickles), but she keeps planning his brilliant future for him instead. Obsessed with the trappings of death, Harold freaks out his blind dates, modifies his new sports car to look like a mini-hearse, and attends funerals, where he meets the spirited Maude (Ruth Gordon). An eccentric to the core, Maude lives exactly as she pleases, with avid collecting and nude modeling among her many pursuits. To the disgust of Harold's relatives and the befuddlement of Harold's shrink, Harold falls in love with her.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: A professional who specialises in 'career transition counseling' (a euphemism for firing people) looks to accomplish his two main goals in life - to accumulate 1 million frequent flier miles, and to land a job at a mysterious management company called MythTech.

Sydney chef George Francisco whips up his legendary Chesapeake Bay crab cakes with a spicy Cajun remoulade. Maeve then learns the secrets of the American barbecue from restaurateur Steve Johnson. And Californian expatriate John Boland shows Maeve how to make his renowned Californian fish tacos.

programme.desc: Bill and Paul ride into their hometown of Bryan-College Station Texas, where the town is being over run by Wild Boars. They head out on a night hunt with state-of-the-art military-grade equipment and Bill bags a big pig. While their pig cooks, they drop in on an eccentric pie maker to learn his secrets, then get back to the roast just in time to serve up some pork pot pie to whole club of hungry bikers.

programme.title: Off The Beaten Track With Kate Humble
programme.desc: In mid-Wales, Kate and Teg have a taste of Stone Age life, mucking in with a farmer and an archaeologist who are building a medieval settlement to bring to life the past in order to understand how we used to live. Obsessed with the trappings of death, Harold freaks out his blind dates, modifies his new sports car to look like a mini-hearse, and attends funerals, where he meets the spirited Maude (Ruth Gordon). Adam ventures into top chef Christian Puglisi's kitchen at Michelin star restaurant Relae, before visiting a pastry chef to make a traditional Danish pastry, Spandauer. Adam shares this treat with author Michael Booth who gives him an insight into the differences between the Nordic countries.

programme.desc: Global food explorer Adam is touring Britain, one incredible, edible place at a time, using the map as his menu to try the best food found here. He’s travelled to Scone in Scotland for a taste of the tattie scone. He also visits a top restaurant in Perth for Scotland's national dish, the famous haggis, neeps and tatties.
